title: Blue Ridge Parkway & Appalachian Twisties Master Loop

tow_rig.engine: 6.7L Cummins High-Output Turbo Diesel Inline-6 (420 hp / 1,075 lb-ft)
tow_rig.transmission: 6-Speed Automatic with Tow/Haul Mode & Exhaust Brake
tow_rig.trailer: 16-Foot Tandem-Axle Enclosed Cargo Trailer (~40 ft combined rig)
tow_rig.payload: 4 Honda Motorcycles + Gear (60/40 front weight bias, ~600 lb tongue weight)

basecamp.name: Eagle's Nest RV, Boat & Vehicle Storage
basecamp.address: 3434 Guard Hill Rd, Front Royal, VA 22630
basecamp.notes: Electronic keypad security gate, wide-aisle enclosed trailer access, 24/7 digital surveillance. 4.5 mi (8 mins) to Skyline Drive North Entrance.

fleet.model: Honda Africa Twin Adventure Sports ES DCT

fleet.role: Cruiser / Fuel Range Governor (Mandatory stops ≤ 100 mi / 161 km)

stages.name: Outbound Transit: Hanmer, ON to Front Royal, VA
stages.lodging: Eagle's Nest RV Storage (Trailer Staged) / Mountain View RV Park
stages.description: Tow vehicle transit haul from Hanmer, ON to Front Royal, VA. Cross border at Queenston-Lewiston Bridge (CBP entry). Stage and padlock truck and 16ft cargo trailer at Eagle's Nest RV Storage.

stages.name: Front Royal Basecamp to Skyline Drive & Waynesboro
stages.pavement: 100% Paved (Skyline Drive National Park Byway • 35 mph limit)
stages.lodging: Charlottesville KOA Holiday (Fallback: The Blackburn Inn)
stages.description: Roll out from Eagle's Nest Storage onto Skyline Drive through Shenandoah National Park. Sweep past Mary's Rock Tunnel, Skyland, and Big Meadows down to Rockfish Gap.

stages.name: Waynesboro to Peaks of Otter & Roanoke
stages.pavement: 100% Paved (Blue Ridge Parkway North Section • MP 0 to 120)
stages.lodging: Lynchburg / Blue Ridge Parkway KOA Holiday (Fallback: The Hotel Roanoke)
stages.description: Enter the Blue Ridge Parkway at Milepost 0.0. Climb past Humpback Rocks, drop to the James River Gorge (lowest elevation on Parkway at 649 ft / 198 m), and summit Peaks of Otter before arriving in Roanoke.

stages.name: Roanoke to Mabry Mill & Blowing Rock, NC
stages.pavement: 100% Paved (Blue Ridge Parkway Central • MP 120 to 291)
stages.description: Ride past the historic Mabry Mill waterwheel for lunch, cross the Virginia/North Carolina border into the High Country, listen to mountain bluegrass at the Blue Ridge Music Center, and ascend to Blowing Rock.

stages.name: Blowing Rock to Mount Mitchell & Cherokee Southern Terminus
stages.pavement: 100% Paved (Blue Ridge Parkway South • Linn Cove Viaduct & Peaks)
stages.lodging: Cherokee / Great Smokies KOA Holiday (Fallback: Harrah's Cherokee Resort)
stages.description: The crown jewel mountain pass: sweep across Linn Cove Viaduct clinging to Grandfather Mountain, summit Mount Mitchell (highest peak east of Mississippi at 6,684 ft / 2,037 m), carve past Craggy Gardens to the southern terminus at Cherokee.

stages.name: Cherokee to Tail of the Dragon, Cherohala Skyway & Bristol
stages.pavement: 100% Paved (US-129 Tail of the Dragon • Cherohala Skyway • I-81/US-421)
stages.lodging: Bristol / Kingsport KOA Holiday (Fallback: The Sessions Hotel)
stages.description: Morning assault on the Tail of the Dragon (US-129: 318 curves in 11 miles), explore Deals Gap Motorcycle Resort, carve the sweeping 5,390 ft high Cherohala Skyway ridge, then transit northeast into Bristol.

stages.name: Bristol through Back of the Dragon (VA-16) to Warm Springs
stages.pavement: 100% Paved (VA Route 16 'Back of the Dragon' • Route 220 • Route 39)
stages.lodging: Natural Bridge / Lexington KOA Holiday (Fallback: The Inn at Gristmill Square)
stages.description: Tackle Virginia Route 16 'Back of the Dragon' (32 mi [51.5 km], 300+ hairpins climbing Walker, Brushy, and Clinch Mountains). Stop at the Tazewell Welcome Center, then carve east across George Washington Forest to Warm Springs.

stages.name: Warm Springs through Highland County to Front Royal Basecamp
stages.pavement: 100% Paved (US-220 • US-250 Highland County • Shenandoah Valley)
stages.lodging: Eagle's Nest RV Storage (Trailer Staged / Rig Retrieved)
stages.description: Climb north through Highland County ('Virginia's Switzerland') into Monterey, sweep east over Shenandoah Mountain, and ride the scenic Shenandoah Valley back to Eagle's Nest Storage to recover the truck and trailer.

stages.name: Return Transit: Front Royal, VA to Hanmer, ON
stages.pavement: 100% Paved (I-99, US-219, I-90, QEW, Hwy 400, Hwy 69 • RAM 2500 Tow)
stages.description: Return transit haul from Front Royal, VA to Hanmer, ON. Cross border at Queenston-Lewiston Bridge (CBSA entry). Grand expedition complete! 2,789.6 mi (4,489.4 km) door-to-door.
